title: Proof of Standing
subtitle: To be filed before, not after, the grievance it supports.
indexBlurb: Establishes that the declaring party exists, is named, and is entitled to be aggrieved. Required as an attachment to Form GC-1, which cannot be filed without it.
instructions: **Before you begin:** standing is not the same as grievance. A party may be gravely wronged and still lack standing to say so. This sheet determines only the latter. It does not determine the former, and nothing on it will be read by anyone who does.

sections.title: Entity Identification

fields.name: entity_name
fields.label: Full legal name of the entity

fields.name: name_is_word
fields.label: Is the entity's name a common word meaning “not known”?
options: Yes, and the irony has been noted internally

fields.name: spelling_variants
fields.label: All spellings of the entity name appearing in your own transmissions
fields.placeholder: Include any containing a transposed consonant
fields.help: Where two spellings appear, the Office registers two entities and requires this form from each.

sections.note: An entity that cannot be distinguished from the absence of an entity is filed under Schedule D.

fields.name: existed_before
fields.label: The entity existed prior to the events complained of.

fields.name: exists_now
fields.label: The entity exists as at the date of this filing.

fields.name: will_exist
fields.label: The entity expects to exist on the date this filing is reviewed.
fields.help: Reviews are scheduled 47 – ∞ business days out. Answer conservatively.

fields.name: basis
fields.label: Basis on which standing is asserted
options: Strength of feeling about the asset concerned
None — asserting standing on general principle

fields.name: prior_declarations
fields.label: Declarations of war previously issued by the entity

fields.name: prior_retracted
fields.label: Of those, how many were retracted

fields.name: prior_unretracted
fields.label: Of those retractions, how many were themselves retracted

fields.name: net_state
fields.label: Resulting net state of belligerence
fields.placeholder: Show your working if the figure is negative

fields.name: own_tag_conduct
fields.label: Describe any occasion on which a member of your entity acted under your tag without instruction, and what you did about it afterwards.
fields.help: Answers here are compared against the position taken in your grievance. They are not compared favourably.

fields.name: signature
fields.label: Signature of the party asserting standing

fields.name: notary
fields.label: Notary public signature
fields.placeholder: Currently on sabbatical — see Form GC-9

finePrint: Establishing standing does not advance any grievance, entitle the declaring party to a response, or oblige the Concern to agree that the entity exists. It permits the filing of Form GC-1, which is itself continuous.

receipt.message: Standing provisionally noted for **{{code}}**, reference **{{ref}}**, queue position **{{queue}}**. You may now begin the grievance itself, which is a separate and longer matter.
footnotes: Note: Provisional standing lapses if not exercised, and cannot be exercised until reviewed.
Note: Your entity has been registered under each spelling supplied. Each will require its own Form GC-1.
Note: The Standing Committee on Standing is currently assessing whether it has standing to assess standing.
